style: Wide cinematic layered paper-cut diorama illustration, handcrafted cut-paper layers with soft shadows between them, warm backlight glowing through the paper, subtle paper texture, tender luminous romantic and serene mood, no text, people never show a visible face.

scenes.prompt: Palette of fresh spring green, pale gold and sky blue. A wide meadow of wildflowers on layered rolling paper hills at sunrise, a gentle breeze lifting petals, a few butterflies, one small blossoming almond tree on the middle hill, golden light, the horizon about 45 percent down from the top, the lower third is soft green meadow with very little detail and low contrast

Palette of fresh green, poppy red and warm gold. A field of tall grasses and red poppies bending in the breeze made of layered paper strips, drifting petals and dandelion seeds in the air, a low golden sun on the right, cut-paper clouds, the lower third is calm grass with very little detail

Palette of fresh green, pink and silver-blue. A single large pink paper flower with many layered petals and a green stem and leaves in close view, filling the upper two thirds, cut-paper raindrops falling around it and glistening on its petals while a sunbeam shines through the rain, a soft blurred green background, the lower third is calm green leaves with very little detail

Palette of gold and blush pink. One single large flowering almond tree with white and pink blossoms standing on a rounded paper hill, golden sunrise glowing behind layered cut-paper clouds, petals floating in the air, the tree centered in the upper two thirds, the lower third is calm grass with very little detail

Palette of lavender, soft blue and warm gold. A small sleeping figure seen from above lying in a meadow of flowers with the face turned away and not visible, above it floating paper petals gathering into the gentle outline of another person's silhouette, a night sky with paper stars, the lower third is calm dark meadow with very little detail
